subject: Password reset — locked out of laptop login
description: Hi IT, I forgot my Windows password over the weekend. I tried three times and now the account is locked. I have MFA set up on my phone. Can someone help me reset it? I need to get in before our 9 AM standup.

subject: Account locked — multiple failed logins from unknown location
description: My account has been locked three times today. I only tried logging in once this morning from my home office. The other lockouts happened while I was in a meeting with no devices open. Something is wrong — I did not attempt those logins. My manager is asking me to report this to IT security immediately.

subject: Laptop extremely slow after startup — 12+ minute boot time
description: Since Tuesday's Windows Update my Dell Latitude 5540 takes over 12 minutes to become usable after login. Task Manager shows 100% disk usage for the first 10 minutes. Everything is sluggish — even opening File Explorer takes 30 seconds. I have restarted several times with no improvement.

subject: Floor 2 HP LaserJet Pro offline — five users blocked
description: The shared HP LaserJet Pro M404dn on the second floor has shown offline in the print queue since 8 AM. At least five people on our team cannot print. We have a client proposal due at noon and need hard copies. I already tried power-cycling the printer but it still shows offline on all our machines.

subject: VPN drops every 20–30 minutes — cannot stay connected remotely
description: I have been working from home all week and my VPN keeps disconnecting every 20 to 30 minutes. When it drops I lose access to the CRM, internal SharePoint, and email. Reconnecting takes 2–3 minutes each time. My home internet is stable — speed test shows 200 Mbps and I have no issues on non-VPN sites. Using GlobalProtect 6.2 client on Windows 11.

subject: Outlook inbox not syncing — missing emails for 18 hours
description: My Outlook desktop client stopped syncing yesterday afternoon around 3 PM. The status bar shows 'Connected' but new emails are not appearing. I can see the missing emails on Outlook Web App (OWA) and on my phone, so the mailbox is fine. I have tried restarting Outlook and running Outlook in safe mode — neither helped. Running Microsoft 365 on Windows 11.

subject: Suspicious phishing email — credential harvesting attempt, did not click
description: I received an email this morning at 7:52 AM appearing to come from 'IT Support <helpdesk@it-corpintranet.net>'. The message claimed my corporate password was expiring in 24 hours and asked me to click a link to a page at 'corp-portal-login.net'. I recognized the domain as fake — our real portal is at portal.example.com. I did NOT click the link. I have forwarded the full email headers to security@example.com as per policy and deleted the original. Attaching screenshot of the email. Flagging in case others received the same message.

subject: No access to Legal shared drive after department transfer
description: I transferred from the Compliance team to Legal three days ago. My old Compliance shared drive (P: drive) has been removed from my profile, which is expected, but I still have no access to the Legal team drive (L: drive). My new manager Rachel Tran submitted an access request on Monday — I have the ticket number from her (REQ-2891). The drive does not appear even after logging off and back on. I need this access to work on the contract review due Friday.
